summary: First-run smoke testing of Toko HP admin panel. Backend auth, inventory CRUD, Luhn validation, duplicate check, profit calc, dashboard, archive, and 401 unauth all PASS. Upload endpoints (image/video) FAIL with 405 due to StaticFiles mount at /api/uploads shadowing POST routes. Frontend login works, dashboard shows stats, inventaris list renders with DD/BULAN/YYYY date format, form page renders with all required fields and Keuangan panel (Total Modal, Estimasi Laba Kotor).
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns user + sets httpOnly access_token & refresh_token cookies
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns all expected keys (total_unit, tersedia, hold, terjual, servis, arsip, nilai_modal_stok, nilai_jual_stok, estimasi_laba_potensial, performa_merek)
POST /api/inventory rejects 15-digit non-Luhn IMEI with 400 (message: 'Checksum IMEI (Luhn) tidak valid')
POST /api/inventory creates unit with valid Luhn IMEI; total_modal=10,500,000, estimasi_laba_kotor=2,500,000 (correct)
PATCH /api/inventory/{id} updates status_stok to HOLD with alasan_hold
Frontend /masuk login with owner@tokohp.id redirects to /admin
Frontend dashboard renders stats cards with Rupiah formatting
Frontend /admin/inventaris lists unit with status badge, date format 08/OKTOBER/2026
Frontend /admin/inventaris/baru form renders with all fields + Scan button + Keuangan panel (Total Modal, Estimasi Laba Kotor)

failed.issue: POST /api/uploads/image and /api/uploads/video return 405 Method Not Allowed. Root cause: in /app/backend/server.py line 41 `app.mount('/api/uploads', StaticFiles(...))` intercepts the entire /api/uploads/* path before the uploads router (included later on line 51) can handle POST requests. StaticFiles only allows GET/HEAD.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/uploads/image with valid PNG multipart -> status 405 body {"detail":"Method Not Allowed"}. Same for /api/uploads/video.

action_items: Fix route conflict in /app/backend/server.py: either (a) mount StaticFiles on a different path like /api/uploads-static and update PUBLIC_UPLOAD_PREFIX, or (b) mount StaticFiles on a sub-path such as /api/uploads/files and adjust routes_uploads.py to return URLs under that sub-path, or (c) use a custom route that serves files only on GET while leaving POST handlers active. The current mount makes upload endpoints unreachable, which will break photo/video upload in the Tambah Unit flow.
